_comment: Per-server ceilings for MCP tool count and definition tokens (name + description + input schema). Enforced by `make lint-mcp-api-reference`. This is a RATCHET: when a consolidation lowers the measured value, lower the ceiling in the same PR. Raising a ceiling requires a justification in the PR description. See .agents/skills/create/references/mcp-tool-consolidation.md. NEVER HAND-MERGE A CONFLICT IN THIS FILE: it is regenerated wholesale, and every PR touches it, so a conflict here is never a real semantic overlap. Re-run the regenerate command below against the merged source and commit its output — do not hand-edit conflict markers or take either side as-is, both silently drop the other side's ceilings (LS-9816). There is deliberately no "total" key: it was always exactly the sum of the per-server ceilings below, so storing it just gave every unrelated PR one more shared line to collide on.
_regenerate: node scripts/generate-mcp-api-reference.mjs --update-budget (or --update-budget=<server-id> to raise just one ceiling)
